title: Accept Changes, Reject Attacks: Robust Memory Management for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41056v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Since large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory, what they store now shapes what they do later. A memory manager decides how each input changes this memory and which records the agent acts on. It can fail in two ways: keeping a fact that has since changed (outdated memory), or storing a planted passage or injected instruction (memory poisoning). Most prior work studies them separately, yet they call for opposite write decisions, so no fixed write rule handles both. We therefore formalize memory robustness as handling both without doing worse on other inputs. Since accuracy checks only the answer, we measure robustness with evidence-conditioned accuracy (ECA), which also checks that the records the manager selects include all the evidence the answer needs, updated and free of attacks. translated_title: 接受变化，拒绝攻击：面向大语言模型智能体的鲁棒记忆管理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.41056v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：由于大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖长期记忆，它们现在存储的内容会塑造它们之后的行为。记忆管理器决定每个输入如何改变这段记忆，以及智能体依据哪些记录采取行动。它可能以两种方式失败：保留已经发生变化的事实（过时记忆），或存储被植入的段落或注入的指令（记忆投毒）。大多数先前的工作将这两种问题分开研究，然而它们要求截然相反的写入决策，因此没有任何固定的写入规则能够同时处理两者。为此，我们将记忆鲁棒性形式化为：在不恶化其他输入表现的前提下，同时应对这两种失败。由于准确率只检查答案本身，我们采用证据条件准确率（ECA）来衡量鲁棒性，它还进一步检查记忆管理器所选的记录是否包含答案所需的全部证据，且这些证据是最新的、未受攻击污染的。然而，实验表明现有的记忆系统和防御方法在我们的测试集上并不比未调优的管理器更鲁棒。我们通过一种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将LLM智能体的记忆鲁棒性形式化为同时应对“过时记忆”与“记忆投毒”两类失败模式，并提出证据条件准确率（ECA）作为衡量记忆管理器鲁棒性的新指标。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes memory robustness for LLM agents as jointly handling outdated memory and memory poisoning, and introduces evidence-conditioned accuracy (ECA) as a new metric to evaluate the robustness of memory managers.
